_note: Per-hunter water rules. A hunter row overrides single keys of default. A null wade_speed_scale or swim_speed_scale takes the runner's value from data/swim/movement.json (wade.speed_scale). Cost fields are path cost multipliers per cell (at least 1). path_cost_deep 0 means path_cost_wade is used when deep water is allowed (can_swim and chasing, or can_swim and not avoids_when_idle).
